detectors.message: select('*') — enumerate columns; never select * on wide/JSONB tables (DL-009).
New/changed VIEW — confirm `security_invoker = true` or it bypasses RLS (DL-008).
FOR ALL policy grants SELECT+INSERT+UPDATE+DELETE with one condition — prefer per-op policies (DL-030).
New table — confirm ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY + policies for every used op (DL-001/DL-016).
Permission/policy path returning true — verify this is not a default-allow (SEC-014).
update/delete on a table — confirm soft-delete filter .is('deleted_at', null) where applicable (DL-014).
